versions.changelog:
Initial release of appliance-energy-audit.

- Analyze which appliances contribute most to your electric bill via a ranked cost-per-appliance table.
- Estimate costs, usage, and standby ("vampire") draw for each device using a preset library or custom inputs.
- Reconcile appliance-model estimates against your real utility bill for accuracy.
- Calculate payback and savings from replacing old appliances with efficient models.
- Supports flat and tiered utility rate structures.
- Includes detailed workflow, command-line usage, and troubleshooting tips.
